description: Figure: residue identity at the GH24 active-site columns across the phi29/c2 clade and the reviewed GH24 outgroup
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
P="/agent/jobs/ffc1da06-19bc-4bb3-abe6-8bfd0bffc082/provenance/clade_position_scoring.csv"
S=pd.read_csv(P)
cl=S[S.grp=="clade"].sort_values("pid",ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
og=S[S.grp=="outgroup"].sort_values("pid",ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
cols=["p15","p23","p24","p25","p26","p27","p28","p32","p37","p41","p60"]
lab=["E11\n(acid)","K19","ins","ins","D20\n(GH24 Asp)","T21","E22","T26\n(Thr)","H31","K35","D70"]
# outgroup D20-column composition
print("Outgroup D20-column residues:"); print(og.p26.value_counts().to_string())
print("\nclade D20-column residues:"); print(cl.p26.value_counts().to_string())
print("\nCaution-flag audit inside the clade (all 45 lack an acidic D20 residue):")
print(pd.crosstab(cl.uniprot_noAsp, cl.acidic_at_D20col).to_string())
print("\nMembers lacking the acidic residue but NOT flagged by UniProt: %d/%d"%((~cl.uniprot_noAsp).sum(),len(cl)))
# Asp41 (T4L K35) occupancy by subgroup
cl["subgrp"]=np.where(cl.org.str.contains("Bacillus"),"Bacillus (phi29-like)","Lactococcus (c2-like)")
print("\ngp15 Asp41 column (T4L K35) by subgroup:"); print(pd.crosstab(cl.subgrp,cl.p41).to_string())

cat=sorted(set(cl[cols].values.ravel())|set(og[cols].values.ravel()))
grp={**{a:0 for a in "AVLIMFWPG"},**{a:1 for a in "STNQYCH"},**{a:2 for a in "KR"},**{a:3 for a in "DE"},"-":4}
cmap=plt.matplotlib.colors.ListedColormap(["#e8e8e8","#bcd9ef","#f2b8c6","#c0392b","#ffffff"])
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,13),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1],"width_ratios":[1,1]})
for ax,df,ttl in [(axes[0],cl,"phi29-like / c2-like clade (n=45)"),(axes[1],og,"reviewed GH24 outgroup (n=23)")]:
    Mx=np.array([[grp.get(v,0) for v in r] for r in df[cols].values])
    ax.imshow(Mx,cmap=cmap,vmin=0,vmax=4,aspect="auto")
    for i in range(len(df)):
        for j,c in enumerate(cols):
            v=df[c].iloc[i]
            ax.text(j,i,v,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7,
                    color="white" if grp.get(v,0)==3 else "black",
                    fontweight="bold" if j==4 else "normal")
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(cols))); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=7)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(df)))
    ax.set_yticklabels([f"{o[:34]} ({a})" for o,a in zip(df.org,df.acc)],fontsize=6)
    ax.set_title(ttl+"\ncolumns labelled by T4 lysozyme position",fontsize=9)
    ax.axvline(3.5,color="k",lw=1.2); ax.axvline(4.5,color="k",lw=1.2)
plt.suptitle("GH24 active-site columns mapped onto phi29 gp15 numbering\nred = Asp/Glu. The T4L Asp20 column carries no acidic residue in any of the 45 clade members",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(5.2,3.6))
f=[0.0,100*og.acidic_at_D20col.mean()]
ax.bar(["phi29/c2 clade\n(n=45)","reviewed GH24\noutgroup (n=23)"],f,color=["#c0392b","#7f8c8d"])
for i,v in enumerate(f): ax.text(i,v+1.5,"%.0f%%"%v,ha="center",fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel("members with Asp or Glu at the T4L Asp20 column (%)")
ax.set_ylim(0,60); ax.set_title("Fisher exact p = 1.7e-05 (0/45 vs 9/23)",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
